speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I notice you have a skin condition we need to evaluate carefully; can you describe the specific lesions you are concerned about, including their size, shape, color, and how they have changed over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and digit. Given the patient's age, heavy smoking history, African origin, and non-healing, crusted lesions unresponsive to previous treatments for syphilis and eczema, there is a high clinical suspicion for malignancy. I will now proceed with a physical examination and request specific diagnostic tests.

REQUEST TEST: Biopsy (Penile and Digit Lesions)
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
REQUEST TEST: HIV_Status

REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology_Clinical_Photographs (Penile and Digit Lesions)
